section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Earned & Remaining
title: A work order discounted below its value shows a negative Total
refs: SV-8660 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 4 S4-E3; S4-R14 negative money format; S4-R29 Adjustments is the signed net of work-order-level fees and discounts)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Adjustments and Total columns are turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. A ZZAUTOTEST open work order exists whose approved and unapproved work adds up to a small amount - for example one approved labor line quoted at $100.00 and nothing else.
4. That work order carries a work-order-level discount larger than that amount - for example a $250.00 discount - and no work-order-level fee.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
2. Find the row for the seeded work order.
3. Read its Earned value, its Remaining value and its Adjustments value.
4. Read the Total value on the same row.
expected:
1. The Adjustments value is negative, because the work-order-level discount outweighs the work-order-level fees on that work order.
2. The Total value is negative, because the discount is larger than Earned and Remaining added together - in the example Earned plus Remaining is $100.00 against a $250.00 discount, so Total reads -$150.00.
3. The negative Total is shown with a leading minus sign in front of the dollar sign, with two decimal places and thousands separators - for example "-$1,234.56".
4. A negative Total on this row is the expected result, not a data error - do not raise a bug for it.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4, S4-E3 and S4-R14), read on 26 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its story SV-8660.
